ai_bootstrap.method: 20-frame storyboard visual review at approximately 2 FPS
limitations: Not independent Human ground truth and cannot pass promotion gate.
2 FPS storyboards can miss short braking, cut-in and lane-departure dynamics.
No ego speed, CAN, depth or calibrated TTC was available.
Full-motion audit is mandatory for all high-priority windows and a sample of negatives.

owner_review_draft.default_policy: All unchanged windows will be accepted only after explicit owner confirmation.
owner_review_draft.important: This draft is not Human-verified and cannot pass the RW-02 promotion gate.
